_meta.what: Upstream recorrido facts this project overrides, with the evidence for each.
_meta.why: The operator's own data lags its network. A stop left on a recorrido after the service stopped making it, a código still listed after the route it named was retired, or a retained variant re-issued under a new id so the rename purge cannot see it, is not a difference of opinion — it is stale data, and publishing it puts a stop on a page that no bus calls at.
_meta.how_to_remove: Every entry is checked on each sync. When upstream stops needing it, the sync logs `no longer needed` for that entry and it should be deleted from this file. Nothing here is meant to outlive the fix upstream.
_meta.rule: An entry needs evidence that stands on its own — the operator's chainage, the route listing, a photograph — recorded in `note`. A correction filed on a hunch is a second wrong answer.

dropStops.note: A61 was extended down the Av. Ciudad de Cali corridor and now runs Tibanica - Primavera → Polo - FINCOMERCIO. Upstream left the old cabecera on the recorrido: it files Portal Américas at `posicion` 0, the same chainage as Tibanica, while every other stop increases from Tibanica (Laureles 541, Islandia 1695 … Polo 21287). Two heads at the same metre is not a sequence, and the service does not call there. Z61, the opposite direction, carries no such entry.

retiredRoutes.note: Replaced by Z61 when the A61/F61 pair was extended to Tibanica. Upstream dropped F61 from `searchRutaByTipo` on 2026-08-18 while A61 stayed, and issued Z61 under a NEW id (5467) rather than re-coding F61's (1190) — so the id-keyed rename purge in `mergeCatalogs` cannot see it and retention would hold the código for its full window. This is the answered retirement that short-circuits that clock.

retiredVariants.note: Pre-closure recorrido of A60, terminating at TM0001 Calle 76. Calle 76 closed for the Metro Línea 1 works and Calle 72 (TM0002) reopened in its place: the 2026-08-25 sync fetched 1233 routes and not one of them calls at TM0001, while 18 variants call at TM0002. Upstream now lists A60 under a NEW id (5711, `Calle 72`) instead of re-coding 1187's, so neither the id-keyed rename purge nor `pruneUnservedStationRoutes` — which reads this variant's own retained recorrido as corroboration — can see it. Querying `infoRuta` for id 1187 answers `codigo A60, nombre "Calle 72"`, ending TM0002: the same route under its pre-closure name.

Both retained variants filed under id 692 ride TM0001 Calle 76 — `Calle 76` terminates there, `Universidades` passes through it. Same closure as A60 above. Upstream now lists código 6 as ids 691 (`Portal 80`) and 5709 (`Calle 72`); id 692 is gone from `searchRutaByTipo` and `infoRuta` for it answers `codigo 6, nombre "Calle 72"` with a 14-stop recorrido ending TM0002.

Retained recorrido runs Flores → TM0001 Calle 76 → Portal Sur, i.e. through the station upstream now files no service at. Unlike A60 and 6 this one has no successor in the listing: código G52 is absent from the 2026-08-25 `searchRutaByTipo` sweep entirely, and `infoRuta` for id 296 answers `{"STATUS":false}` with no route object at all. The absence alone would prove nothing (that is what retention is for) — what is answered here is the recorrido: a variant whose own stop list rides a closed station is stale whether or not the código comes back.
retiredVariants.amended: 2026-08-28. G52 is NOT retired. TRANSMILENIO's own Calle 76 closure notice lists it among the services at Calle 72, on Vagón 2. So the service runs, re-routed off Calle 76 like every other one here, and only its recorrido is unpublished — this entry drops a stale stop list, which is still right, and says nothing about the código being gone. There is nothing to restore: upstream serves no recorrido for G52 at all, and writing one by hand would invent a path (§1). Consequence to know: G52 is absent from this app entirely until upstream republishes it, which is a gap the notice proves rather than hides. Delete this entry the moment it comes back — the sync already names it as unused once it has nothing left to match.
